history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: 'Neelakantheswar' (Neelakantha = the blue-throated Shiva) is a generic Shiva-shrine name, and there are several shrines of this name in Nayagarh district, Odisha: one at Itamati (~20.177, 85.128), one listed at Nayagarh itself (~20.131, 85.137), one at Sarankul (~20.043, 85.048), and a Sri Sri Nilakantheswara temple at Benagadia village near Kantilo. No web source with a written description, history, or reliable timings was found for any one of them; only map-place listings exist. This file documents the 'Nilakantheswar Temple, Nayagarh 752079' returned by geocoding against the CSV town 'Nayagarh' (20.10948, 85.16658) as the best-supported referent, but the identity is UNCERTAIN - verify on the ground which shrine the CSV row intends. This is distinct from the famous 7th-century Nilakantheswar/Manikeswar Siva temple at Padmapur in Rayagada district (often described as a Buddhist-associated site) - a completely different temple that must not be confused with this row.
